meta.where: Two review points in Production: (1) the cast voice preview of a character (mode 'cast'), (2) the voice plan of a block before generation (mode 'bind'). Clip-level sound problems after generation are reported through VIDEO_REVIEW / G07 and routed here only when the cause is the voice itself.
meta.flow: UI asks technical or preference (RV01), shows the reasons below, collects targets (tap a line or the character card) and optional text, then sends fix_requests with previous_output. Several requests can be sent in one round.
meta.suggestion_after_max_rounds: Offer: pick another voice from the full catalog list by ear, upload a recording instead, or let the video make this voice.

rules.dialogue_text: No code changes the words of a line. Requests about wording are sent to the script stage.
rules.cast_change: A change to an approved cast voice affects every block where the character speaks. The UI asks for confirmation and lists those blocks; already accepted clips are kept as versions and marked 'voice changed'.
rules.real_people: Requests to sound like a named real person are not applied; the dami offers an audible description instead.
rules.consent: Uploading another person's voice requires the VO06 confirmation before any dami round.

technical.label: Wrong language or accent
technical.instruction: Re-pick from the catalog with dialogue_language and the stated accent as hard filters; update voice_design_prompt.

technical.label: Wrong age or gender for this character
technical.label_fa: سن یا جنسیت صدا با شخصیت نمی‌خواند
technical.instruction: Re-check age and gender facts in output_21, re-filter age_band, re-pick. custom_text may state the intended age.
technical.ui_note: Text box optional: 'How old should they sound?'

technical.label: The voice has noise, echo or glitches
technical.label_fa: صدا نویز، اکو یا خرابی دارد
technical.instruction: Backend regenerates the preview once. If it repeats, the dami drops that voice_id from picks and adds clean-recording terms to voice_design_prompt.

technical.label: A line is missing or said wrong
technical.label_fa: یک دیالوگ جا افتاده یا اشتباه گفته شده
technical.instruction: Backend regenerates the TTS request for the line once. If the text in tts_requests differs from the line, the dami restores the exact line.

technical.label: Mispronounced word or name
technical.label_fa: کلمه یا اسمی اشتباه تلفظ شده
technical.instruction: Add a pronunciation hint for the word in delivery (and a phonetic respelling only in a separate pronunciation field if the engine supports it). Never change the line's text.
technical.ui_note: Text box: 'Which word, and how is it said?'

technical.label: The line is too long for its moment
technical.label_fa: دیالوگ برای این لحظه طولانی است
technical.instruction: Set retime_request 'faster' once. If the line still overruns, return a timing warning so the block goes to BLOCK_REVISION to widen the window.

technical.label: The voice starts at the wrong moment
technical.label_fa: صدا در لحظهٔ اشتباه شروع می‌شود
technical.instruction: Move start_ms inside the line's window as described (earlier, later, after a named action). Keep the gap rules.

technical.label: The wrong person is speaking
technical.instruction: Check speaker_id against the block's dialogue and the scene's speakers; fix the voice_id and the speaker name next to the audio token.

preference.label: Deeper / higher
preference.instruction: Re-pick with the pitch moved one step in the chosen direction; keep age, accent and language.

preference.label: Softer / rougher
preference.instruction: Re-pick with texture moved in the chosen direction; keep everything else.

preference.label: Doesn't feel like this character
preference.instruction: Rewrite the voice brief from custom_text plus stated facts; never contradict voice_hints from the script. Re-pick.

preference.label: More emotion / calmer
preference.instruction: Adjust delivery, tags (if supported) and stability for the targeted line only.
preference.ui_note: Tap the line, then a button.

preference.label: Faster / slower
preference.instruction: Set retime_request; slower only while the line still fits max_ms, otherwise return a timing warning.

preference.label: Change how this shot's voices are made
preference.label_fa: روش ساخت صدای این نما را عوض کن
preference.instruction: Return to the three-option question for the block; bind runs again with the new choice.

preference.label: Something else
preference.instruction: Apply custom_text within the rules (no wording changes, no real-person voices); explain anything not applied.
